description: Bounded public disposition for Alice MTP correctness and the FreeToken-inspired staging/overlap programme: the Alice-local recurrent conv snapshot plane defect, the known-answer test moving from 276/682 failing to 0/682, greedy parity at K = 0/2/3/4 in the corrected lane, the standalone HIP overlap probe (copy fully hidden on a separate stream), and the production F2 A/B null at ub512. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base (custom alice_ai hybrid KDA linear-attention + MoE)
model_revision: source checkpoint; the quantized container is excluded from publication
model_download_source: public base checkpoint exists; no weight payload or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: Q3.9-MIX (52 x Q4_K + 44 x Q3_K expert tensors, trunk q8_0, control f32)
hardware_phenotype: RX9060XT16-NITRO-GFX1200-RADV-2026.08.27-v1; RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP and Vulkan builds of the same research runtime
gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP and Vulkan builds of the same research runtime
prompt: model-free KAT fixtures for the correctness lane; production A/B used the campaign prefill prompt shape
context_size: 8192 for the staging A/B; the KAT is context-free
warmup: three identical-shape requests per arm in the A/B; KAT is deterministic and model-free

expected_range.defect_location: Alice-local recurrent conv snapshot plane convention
expected_range.defect_expression: offset used min(slot, n_seq_tokens) instead of n_seq_tokens - slot
expected_range.invariant: snapshot plane written for token j must be the plane rollback selects for depth j
expected_range.targeted_second_slot_outcome: did not load: two allocator failures then segfault before readiness

tolerance.f2_ab: interleaved A/B/A/B/A/B in one lease; verdict is the median comparison

known_limitations: The KAT is a model-free test in a tree that is not published, so the lane is a disposition, not a rerunnable public test.
The F2 programme produced no speedup: the candidate arm is a deficit, not a win.
The standalone probe proves the overlap mechanism in isolation only; no production win follows from it.
The coarse and targeted second-slot designs both failed to produce a loaded candidate arm.
